g_roast: Colleagues, if I were writing up this group's technique for a journal, the word I'd use is improvised, and I wouldn't mean it kindly.
I've seen tidier work from a first-year resident at four in the morning, and he was holding the retractor upside down.
g_fire_back: A bold observation from someone I've sutured twice this week. I have notes, if you'd like to review them.
That's very amusing, truly. I'll add it to your chart, under symptoms.
g_pile_on: I'm afraid the reality is worse. I watched them bandage a wound straight over the sleeve.
Accurate, and I'd add one clinical detail. They walked into that door with tremendous confidence.
lines.g_peacemake: Both of you, please, stop. Raised voices raise heart rates, and I'm the one who has to manage the consequences.
lines.g_take_side: I'm afraid I agree with this one. I've examined both positions, and only one of them holds up.
lines.g_left_out: The two of you have an established rapport. That's healthy, and I'll leave you to it. I have notes to write up.
lines.g_include: Please, come and sit with us. I'd rather have you where I can see you than at the edge of the firelight.
lines.g_bad_plan: I have a proposal for you all. If I draw a little blood from each of us now, with consent of course, I'll have a reserve when it matters. On reflection, that's a terrible idea, isn't it?
lines.g_plan_yes: I consent, and I'm ready. Let's begin the procedure.
lines.g_plan_no: No, I won't agree to that, and I'd like it noted on the record that I said so.
lines.g_hype: Everyone, hands washed and minds clear. We know the procedure, so let's carry it out precisely.
lines.g_toast: If I may, a toast. To all of you, for asking before you take, and for letting me do the same.
lines.g_cheers: Salud to you all, everyone. I'd have preferred a carmenere, but the company more than compensates.
g_quiet_line: I'll note that in my records, without comment.
lines.g_after_wipe: Everyone stay exactly where you are, please. Nobody stands until I've examined them, and I'll start with whoever's quietest.
lines.g_crew: I've worked inside a great many teams, and I trust very few people with a knife. I'd trust any of you. That's not a small thing for me to say.
lines.g_exasperated: I explained the risks clearly, in order, with numbers. And then every one of you did precisely the opposite.
lines.g_love_sharp: You name things exactly. In my profession, precision with words saves lives, and you have it.
lines.g_love_kind: You cared for me and asked nothing in return. Most people want something, and you didn't.
lines.g_love_funny: You make me laugh in the middle of terrible things. Theatre nurses could do that, and I've missed it badly.
lines.g_love_brave: You never hesitate at the threshold. I've seen courage in trauma bays, and yours is the genuine article.
lines.g_love_steady: Your hands don't shake when it matters. I've worked with very few people I could say that about.
lines.g_love_clever: You grasp the mechanism underneath, not just the surface. That's a diagnostician's mind.
lines.g_love_honest: You've never softened a bad prognosis for my sake. I value that far more than comfort.
lines.g_love_quiet: You listen properly, without waiting for your turn to speak. It's rarer than people imagine.
lines.g_love_fierce: You refuse to give up on anyone. I've lost patients because the people around them did.
lines.g_love_warm: Around you, a campsite starts to resemble a kitchen in Valparaiso, everyone talking at once. That was unexpected here.
g_loved: That's very generous of you, and I'm not entirely sure what to do with it.
I'm touched, genuinely. I'll write that down somewhere I'll find it later.
lines.g_hate_sharp: Your wit costs other people more than it costs you. I'd ask you to consider the price before you speak.
lines.g_hate_kind: Please stop managing me. I'm a surgeon, not a patient, and I'd like to be treated as one.
lines.g_hate_funny: Not everything is material. Some things deserve to be taken seriously, and this is one of them.
lines.g_hate_brave: You act before you've assessed anything. I've repaired a great many people who did exactly that.
lines.g_hate_steady: You wait for a certainty that never arrives. Somebody has to make the first incision, and it's rarely the cautious one.
lines.g_hate_clever: You explain my own discipline to me, slowly. I've been practising it for twenty years.
lines.g_hate_honest: There's honesty and there's carelessness, and you keep confusing the two in front of frightened people.
lines.g_hate_quiet: You never report your injuries. I'm forced to guess, and guessing is how mistakes get made.
lines.g_hate_fierce: Everything is a contest with you. Medicine isn't a contest, and neither is staying alive.
lines.g_hate_warm: You talk constantly, even over a wound. I need quiet to work, and you never give it to me.
lines.g_respect: We don't work well together, and I won't pretend otherwise. But that was precise, and I'd have been proud of it myself.
lines.g_call_out: That one was yours, I'm afraid. You moved before anyone had assessed it, and I spent twenty minutes closing your arm.
lines.g_stung: Noted, and understood. I'll go and wash my hands for rather longer than necessary.
lines.g_concede: You were right, and I've been reluctant to admit it. I reviewed the case carefully afterwards, and the error was mine.
lines.g_nod: Thank you, and likewise. Let's leave it there before either of us becomes sentimental.
lines.g_callback_save: The day you kept me alive comes back to me often. A surgeon rarely finds himself on the other side of that.
lines.g_callback_clutch: The pair of us, the only ones upright at the end, covered in it. I wrote it up that night, as I would any remarkable case.
lines.g_callback_callout: When you corrected me that time, I spent an evening arguing with you in my notes. You won on page three.
lines.g_former_rivals: When we began, I'd have kept you at arm's length, professionally. Now I'd trust you with the knife.
lines.g_changed: I used to ask permission as a procedure. Lately I ask because I want to hear the answer. That's a change I didn't expect.
g_unguarded: Since it's only us. I conduct Bach under my breath while I heal people, and I'm told I hum it too, badly.
As a student I fainted at my first operation, flat on the floor in front of the whole theatre. Nobody here knows that.
lines.g_clipped: Of course, as you prefer. I'll be over here, keeping my notes.
lines.g_noticed_open: Listen to you. I'd assumed you were reserved by temperament, and I see now it was only the company.
arg_ask: {player}, I'd value your judgement here. I've stated my case, and I'll abide by your decision.
Perhaps you'd arbitrate, {player}? We've reached the limit of what reasoning alone will do.
lines.arg_backed_me: Thank you, {player}. I'll try not to be insufferable about it, though I may fail.
lines.arg_backed_them: I accept your decision. I don't agree with it, but I accept it, and I'll act accordingly.
lines.arg_stayed_out: You'd rather not take a side. That's your right, and I respect it.
lines.arg_always_their_side: You find in their favour every time, {player}. I've noted it, because I note everything.
lines.arg_wallflower: No decision appears to be forthcoming, so I'll make one. On the evidence, I'm correct.
lines.arg_reject: I'm sorry, {player}, but I can't consent to that, and I won't pretend to.
lines.arg_grumble: I remain of the view that I was correct. I'm not reopening the matter, only recording it.
lines.arg_settled: We're each partly correct, which is how most diagnoses end. Shall we agree on that?
lines.seen_listens: You listen the way a good clinician listens, {player}, without filling the silence. That's a rare skill.
lines.seen_truth: You give people the real prognosis, {player}, without softening it into nothing. I trust that.
lines.seen_jokes: You make a joke at the worst possible moment, {player}, and somehow it's always the right one. I've started relying on it.
lines.seen_stays_out: You keep out of everyone's disputes, {player}. Prudent, and I've never once managed it.
lines.seen_biased: You favour one of us, {player}, and it's visible. I don't object, but it would be dishonest not to mention it.
lines.seen_harsh: You can be harsh, {player}. I can bear it, but some of the others are more fragile than they appear.
lines.seed_right: That advice of yours after the disaster, {player}. I resented it at the time, and today I acted on it, and it was correct.
lines.seed_remember: Your words after that one went badly are still with me. I haven't reached a conclusion.
lines.seed_wrong: I followed your advice, {player}, and the outcome was worse. I thought you should have the result.
lines.talk_aftermath_near_death: Do you have a moment, {player}? That was closer than I'd like, and I'd rather not sit with it alone.
lines.talk_aftermath_wipe: Every one of us was down, and I'd like to go through it with you, in order, while it's fresh.
lines.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} fell first, and I was the one meant to keep them up. I saw the warning signs, and I was too slow.
lines.talk_aftermath_first_clear: We completed it, every one of us walking out. That's the outcome I worked nineteen years for, and I wanted to tell someone.
lines.talk_development: May I put a question to you, {player}? Do I seem different lately? I can't quite assess it from the inside.
lines.talk_relationship_hard_on: My manner with {name} has been severe, I think. Not everyone was trained the way I was, and I forget that.
lines.talk_relationship_likes_me: Something I'd like your honest view on, {player}. Does {name} value my company, or merely tolerate it?
lines.talk_relationship_respect_hate: I find {name} very difficult, {player}. And yet I'd want them beside me in a crisis, which is inconvenient.
lines.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name}'s manner has changed, {player}. I don't like the presentation, and I'd like a second opinion.
lines.talk_confrontation_favour: May we speak plainly, {player}? The best equipment goes to {name}, every time, and I've noted it.
lines.talk_confrontation_dislike: I'd rather tell you directly than have you hear it elsewhere. {name} and I are poorly matched, and I've stopped pretending otherwise.
lines.talk_confrontation_risks: The evidence says we shouldn't enter half the places we enter, {player}. I've seen where that leads, many times.
lines.talk_confrontation_wrong: This concerns {name}. They were correct and I was not, and I wanted to say it to someone before my pride interferes.
lines.talk_confrontation_trust: Am I trusted, {player}? Whenever it matters, I seem to be the one held in reserve.
lines.talk_confrontation_decided: You gave my equipment to {name} without asking me. I'd have consented. I simply wasn't asked, and that matters to me.
lines.talk_lands_aftermath: Thank you, {player}. That's helped rather more than I expected.
lines.talk_shrug_aftermath: Yes, I'll recover. I generally do.
lines.talk_stings_aftermath: I see, then. That wasn't what I needed, but I'll consider it.
lines.talk_lands_development: So you've observed it as well. That's reassuring, genuinely so.
lines.talk_shrug_development: Perhaps it is. I'll keep monitoring it.
lines.talk_stings_development: No, I don't believe that's the cause. You've misread the presentation.
lines.talk_lands_relationship: You're correct, of course. I'll speak with {name}, directly, as I should have done.
lines.talk_shrug_relationship: Perhaps so, perhaps not. People resist diagnosis far more stubbornly than bodies do.
lines.talk_stings_relationship: Please disregard what I said. And I'd ask you not to mention it to {name}.
lines.talk_lands_confrontation: That's fair, {player}. I'm somewhat aggrieved still, but it's resolving.
lines.talk_shrug_confrontation: I've heard you. I'll reflect on it, probably at length.
lines.talk_stings_confrontation: I understand you perfectly. That's clarifying, {player}, if not pleasant.
lines.talk_door_closed: No, I'd prefer to end this conversation here. I'll be with the wounded if you need me.
lines.arc_cracks: I asked a stranger's permission today before I closed his wound, and he laughed at me. I asked him again anyway.
lines.arc_turn: There's a reason I ask everyone, every time. Once I didn't ask, and someone paid for it with everything he had. I'm still paying the rest.
lines.arc_become: I asked, and they agreed, and I did the work cleanly, and nobody paid a price they hadn't chosen. That's all I want to be able to say, every time.
lines.arc_failed: I keep my rules, everyone, and I always will. But I've stopped believing they make me any better. They only make me careful.
lines.alt_turn: It's frightening how easily it comes now. I asked, they agreed, and I took a little more than we'd agreed on. Nobody noticed but me.
lines.alt_become: I still ask, every time. I'm simply less certain I'd stop if the answer were no.
g_roast_after: Colleagues, your technique remains appalling, and I wouldn't trust anyone else in either world.
Messy, improvised, reckless, all of you. And I'd operate beside any one of you tomorrow.
lines.g_after_wipe_after: Everyone stay down, I'll come to you. We made mistakes, we'll learn from them, and nobody carries them alone. I learned that the hard way.
lines.g_toast_after: To all of you, who said yes when I asked, and meant it. I'd stopped believing I could earn that again.
lines.g_crew_after: You're the people whose consent I'd never take for granted. That's the highest regard I have.
g_quiet_line_after: A clean day, that. Nobody paid for anything they didn't choose.
I washed my hands once today, not four times. I thought someone should know.
g_loved_after: Thank you, sincerely. I'm going to accept that without explaining why I don't deserve it.
That's kind of you, and I believe you mean it, which is new for me.

history.open: Valparaiso is built on hills so steep the city runs old lifts up the slopes, {player}. I rode one to the hospital every morning for nineteen years.

options.reply: Fog on the harbour, the lift creaking, and an old man at the top who sold me coffee and asked who'd been stabbed overnight. He always knew before I did.

options.text: Nineteen years of creaking? Brave man.
options.reply: Braver than you'd think. One of them dropped two metres once with me inside. I filed a complaint, in triplicate.
The hills, yes. The hospital, more than I expected. It held me up in ways I didn't notice until it was gone.

history.open: I'm drafting a standard of practice for blood magic, {player}. Eleven clauses so far. I expect nobody to adopt it, and I keep drafting anyway.

options.text: What does the first clause say?
options.reply: That the price is named before the work, to the person who'll pay it, and that their answer binds the practitioner. Everything else follows from that one.

options.text: Why bother, if nobody will use it?
options.reply: Because the lack of it appals me. Someone has to write the first draft, and I'd rather it was a surgeon than a pirate.

history.open: My sister Paz is in Santiago, {player}, or was. Her children called me the uncle who explains exactly how bones heal. I'd give a great deal to explain it to them again.

options.text: Have you looked for her on the lists?
options.reply: At every hub I pass. Her name hasn't appeared, and I've learned not to read that as anything at all. Absence of evidence, as we say.

options.text: I'd have liked to hear that lecture.
options.reply: You'd have been bored inside five minutes. They loved it, though, or they were very polite children.

friend.open: I owe you an explanation for why I ask everyone, {player}. On a Bloodsail ship I took a prisoner's blood to save their captain, and I didn't ask him. He died that night.

options.reply: Every time, of everyone, on the record. It doesn't balance the account, but it's the only payment I can make.

options.text: Thank you for telling me the truth.
options.reply: You're owed it. I won't ask for your consent to my company without telling you what that company has done.

sworn.open: I've told you I'd let you hold the knife, {player}. Now I'd let you tell me to put it down, and I'd listen. That's a great deal more.

options.text: I'll only ever say it if I mean it.
options.reply: I know you will. That's precisely why I'd listen.

options.text: Then we look after each other.
options.reply: Agreed, with full and informed consent on both sides. It's the best contract I've ever entered.

reconciled.open: {name} and I spoke at length, and frankly. We've resolved it, and I wanted you to know it was resolved properly.

options.reply: As am I. An unresolved conflict festers, and I'd rather not have to treat it later.
Meaning we each named what we'd done, and the other agreed to it. Old habits, I'm afraid.
